description: This file contains functions for managing events within the BORIS behavioral observation software, including adding, editing, deleting, copying, pasting, filtering, and undoing event operations, as well as handling event-specific data like time, comments, subjects, behaviors, and images.

classes.name: DlgEditEvent
classes.description: Dialog class for editing or adding an event, including fields for time, subject, behavior, comment, image, and modifiers.

classes.name: EditSelectedEvents
classes.description: Dialog class for editing multiple selected events at once.

classes.name: dialog.FindInEvents
classes.description: Dialog class for finding text within events.

classes.name: dialog.FindReplaceEvents
classes.description: Dialog class for find and replace operations within events.

classes.name: dialog.Ask_time
classes.description: Dialog class for asking user input for time shifts.

methods.name: add_event
methods.description: Manually adds a new event to the current observation, handling different event types such as media, images, and live.

methods.name: find_events
methods.description: Opens a dialog to find specific text within selected events.

methods.name: find_replace_events
methods.description: Opens a dialog to perform find and replace operations within selected events.

methods.name: filter_events
methods.description: Filters events based on selected subject and behavior categories.

methods.name: show_all_events
methods.description: Removes filters to show all events.

methods.name: fill_events_undo_list
methods.description: Stores current events state for undo operations.

methods.name: undo_event_operation
methods.description: Reverts the last event operation using the undo queue.

methods.name: delete_all_events
methods.description: Deletes all events in the current observation, with confirmation.

methods.name: select_events_between_activated
methods.description: Selects events within a specified time interval.

methods.name: add_comment
methods.description: Adds or edits a comment for selected events.

methods.name: edit_selected_events
methods.description: Edits multiple selected events for subject, behavior, and comment.

methods.name: edit_event
methods.description: Edits a single event based on the selected row.

methods.name: edit_time_selected_events
methods.description: Shifts the time of selected events by a specified amount.

methods.name: copy_selected_events
methods.description: Copies selected events to the clipboard.

methods.name: paste_clipboard_to_events
methods.description: Pastes events from the clipboard into the current observation.

methods.name: read_event_field
methods.description: Retrieves a specific field value from an event, or NA if unavailable.

methods.name: add_frame_indexes
methods.description: Adds frame index data to events based on media playback.
